The '''Toxic Lake Garrison''' was the headquarters for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] operations on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the subsequent [[Galactic War]].
